original_question: Write the Verilog code for a module named `sky130_fd_sc_hd__a41oi`. The module should have the following interface: inputs `A1`, `A2`, `A3`, `A4`, and `B1`, and output `Y`. The functionality of the module is such that the output `Y` is the logical inversion of the result of logically ORing input `B1` with the logical AND of inputs `A1`, `A2`, `A3`, and `A4`.
